title: Master Agent Continuous Learning & Self-Fix Loop
description: The Master Agent serves as a parallel cognitive observer. It parses user interactions, extracts emerging rules and preferences, and acts as an advisor to help the main agent self-fix.
loop_architecture: Transcript Ingestion: Read transcript.jsonl after each turn.
Pattern Extraction: Extract user commands, corrections, and tool instructions.
Card Generation / Update: Store updated insights in understanding_master/.
Advisory Callback: When Job Agent encounters a dilemma, query Master Agent for 'What would the User do?'
